intro: This is Common Area: a shared online plaza where friends study, play, and hang out together. There is no account and nothing to install. Pick a name, pick a look, and walk in.
plaza: Everyone you see in the plaza is a real player. Say hello in the chat.
study: Sit down at a table with classmates. Every focused minute earns Soo, the game's currency. After twenty-five minutes, a short quiz pays a bonus.
gameroom: Break time. The Game Room has shared tables for Ludo, Colour Cards, Werewolf, and Colour Match.
cards: Here is a round of Colour Cards with two classmates. The server is the referee: it deals the cards, checks every move, and runs a twenty-second turn clock. Each table has its own chat.
friends: Back in the plaza, click any player to send a friend request.
friends2: Once they accept, they appear in your Friends list, and you can visit their garden at any time, even when they are offline.
visit: This is Lin's garden. Leave a like: it pays her a little Soo.
garden: The Soo you earn by studying pays for your own island: crops, fruit trees, a fish tank, animals, and a house to furnish.
garden2: Plants grow in real time, so there is always a reason to come back. Harvest, then plant again.
forest: Through the east gate is the Quiet Forest, with fishing, a café, and a bonus for studying there.
end: Common Area. Study, play, and hang out together, in any browser, and as an Android app.
